scope: One eligible unprotected equal-exposure nonroot actual two-port splice; no iteration/hybrid bound/code catalogue/certificate consumer is claimed.
root_owned_rate_implementation: research/2026-10-14-astra-equal-exposure-splice-0350z; still separately owned/reviewed, no version selected or altered by this design.
proposed_inputs: S : G1ActualGraphNormalization.Source X, including literal RootedBinary/CutChild/Calendar
H : OriginalParentRegistry S.network; p : HybridProbabilities S.network; r : PositivePairRates S.Edge
b : S.network.graph.Blob; hb : b is not the root blob; hp : card (S.network.BlobPort b) = 2
A is exactly the extractedBigon used by G1ActualGraphNormalization.splice S b hb hp
Equal coalescent exposures of A.fragment.parents.parent0 and parent1
Fixed expanded injective PE edge labels avoid removedEdges; PH hybrid labels avoid the removed hybrid
Actual outer-semidirected partner of S for the admission corollary

new_proof_obligations.conclusion: Construct J : Hybrid T.network ↪ Hybrid S.network and Hprime preserving each original ordered parent edge occurrence via Sum.inl; pprime.gamma = p.gamma composed with J. Prove range(J) is all old hybrids except the removed one.
new_proof_obligations.method: actual_splice_hybrid_iff, actual_in_edge_kept_of_ne_child and actual_child_target_not_hybrid; subtype/parent target/distinctness proofs. Never canonicalParentRegistry.

new_proof_obligations.conclusion: For every original bank coin, commonSwitching T.network Hprime (coin composed with J) equals restrictSwitching of commonSwitching S.network H coin.
new_proof_obligations.method: Literal commonSwitching definition and switching_ext. Retained original parent bits remain oriented; synthetic ordinary edge is kept. liftSwitching supplies one deleted-arm lift, not the bank marginal.

new_proof_obligations.conclusion: For every original bank, weightedNormalize of the constructed new tuple at coin composed with J equals original weightedNormalize at coin.
new_proof_obligations.method: edgeTaxa_selected_descendants plus actual_retained_selected_descendants_iff; upper/hybrid descendants equal child interface; common_route_kept gives empty clade on the unchosen arm. Group entry+chosenarm+child by their identical clade, replace with new-edge exposure; proper-clade finite sums, empty/full normalized to zero.

new_proof_obligations.conclusion: Map originalRegisterMeasure.toPMF through coin -> coin composed with J equals the actual new originalRegisterMeasure.toPMF.
new_proof_obligations.method: Use its literal independent original-site Bernoulli product, pprime gamma pullback, J range excluding exactly the deleted hybrid; sum that coordinate to (1-gamma)+gamma=1. Preserve the entire retained joint bank. This does not factor the supplied correlated configuration PMF.

new_proof_obligations.conclusion: Pullback commutes pointwise with overrideBank; the same future joint PMF and original external mask table give equal randomizedTreeLaw and hence randomizedFullForestLaw for all finite Copy/sample.
new_proof_obligations.method: Apply proved fixed-bank identity to overridden bank, bank pushforward and actual configurationBankPMF; finally existing randomized_tree_law_eq_all_forest_responses. No output equality is a source record field or premise.

new_proof_obligations.conclusion: Transport fixed PE/PH labels with exact rate/date/gamma and raw-edge identity; derive outer witness for exact T=splice S b hb hp.
new_proof_obligations.method: Literal retained-edge/hybrid embeddings and rates; existing actual_step_preserves_outer_semidirected_partner applied to Step.splice. Any adapter using arbitrary A instead must prove equality to that exact extracted splice, not assume outer admission.

public_quantifiers: Construct T,J,Hprime,pprime,rprime and external label images from fixed source/cell/marks once. Then quantify universally over original bank, future Config/PMF/masks and Copy/sample. No unknown target or desired law/cardinality/source-existence premise. COMMON only; no independent-pulse, timed-law, changed-parameter-menu or arbitrary-unmarked-tie extension.
specific_cautions: ratesFromLengths resets ancestral=1; use root constructor preserving old ancestral rate literally.
Parallel arms have the same actual endpoints, but exposure equality must stay explicit; do not conclude arbitrary arms have equal calendar durations.
The bigon fragment parent0 can differ from supplied H parent0. Preserve H order on retained hybrids; prove deletion is branch-independent by equal exposure, not by relabelling bits.
Finite source/direct-import hashes are authenticated locally; no official query/compilation or placeholder/axiom execution is claimed.

theorem actual_common_completed_weighted_tree_law (N : RootedBinary V E X)
    (C : Calendar N.graph) (H : OriginalParentRegistry N) (p : HybridProbabilities N)
    (r : PositivePairRates E) (sample : Copy → X) (coin : CommonSeed N) :
    ((sourceProgram N r (compiledCalendarProgram N C H (originalGamma p) (fun _ => true))
      (initialCode N sample (originalRegister N coin))).bind
        (ancestralCompletion N r (Fintype.card Copy))).map
          (fun d => sourceUnrankedForest (state d) Finset.univ) =
      ordinaryCompletedTreeLaw (weightedNormalize N C H r coin) sample := by

theorem actual_controlled_completed_weighted_tree_law (N : RootedBinary V E X)
    (C : Calendar N.graph) (H : OriginalParentRegistry N) (p : HybridProbabilities N)
    (r : PositivePairRates E) (mask : OriginalMask N) (sample : Copy → X)
    (coin : CommonSeed N) :
    ((sourceProgram N r (controlledCalendarProgram N C H p (fun _ => true) mask)
      (initialCode N sample (originalRegister N coin))).bind
        (ancestralCompletion N r (Fintype.card Copy))).map
          (fun d => sourceUnrankedForest (state d) Finset.univ) =
      ordinaryCompletedTreeLaw (weightedNormalize N C H r (overrideBank N mask coin)) sample := by

    (ν : PMF Config) (masks : Config → OriginalMask N) (sample : Copy → X) :

lemma randomized_tree_law_eq_all_forest_responses
    {V' E' Config' : Type*} [Fintype V'] [Fintype E'] [Fintype Config']
    [DecidableEq V'] [DecidableEq E']
    (N : RootedBinary V E X) (C : Calendar N.graph) (H : OriginalParentRegistry N)
    (p : HybridProbabilities N) (r : PositivePairRates E)
    (ν : PMF Config) (masks : Config → OriginalMask N)
    (N' : RootedBinary V' E' X) (C' : Calendar N'.graph) (H' : OriginalParentRegistry N')
    (p' : HybridProbabilities N') (r' : PositivePairRates E')
    (ν' : PMF Config') (masks' : Config' → OriginalMask N')
    (he : randomizedTreeLaw N' C' H' p' r' ν' masks' = randomizedTreeLaw N C H p r ν masks)
    (Copy : Type*) [Fintype Copy] [DecidableEq Copy] (sample : Copy → X) :
    randomizedFullForestLaw N' C' H' p' r' ν' masks' sample =
      randomizedFullForestLaw N C H p r ν masks sample := by
